purpose: Conceptual narrative illustration of coach dialogue versus separate SkillPilot curriculum, progress and plan; not a real UI, privacy certification, or provider acceptance evidence.
prompt:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: language-neutral PNG illustration for the SkillPilot Whitepaper, one of a six-scene visual story.
Primary request: Make it immediately clear that a friendly AI coach helps with the conversation while a separate stable SkillPilot learning map keeps achieved learning goals, the current goal and a small plan together across learning sessions.
Scene: warm ivory background, a welcoming simple desk scene, no dense UI. On the left an older upper-secondary/young adult learner with warm brown skin, dark curly hair, teal sweater, holding a smartphone showing a friendly small white-and-blue robot avatar and two plain chat bubbles. The human is thoughtful and active, not being replaced by the robot. On the right a large tangible learning board firmly supported on a stone foundation: three blue/teal skill blocks with small checked circles support an amber-orange current skill block without a check; pale outlined blocks above show future learning. The blocks bear only simple maths/physics pictograms. Beside the blocks a small simple calendar card with a highlighted day. A few separated round blue/orange tokens visually connect phone and board, symbolizing structured learning-state exchange, not a stream of chat transcripts or uploaded paper. Only one phone and one board.
Style: friendly abstract hand-drawn educational comic, dark soft ink outlines, lightly textured warm colors, restrained shading, expressive natural face, readable large shapes. Match a warm comic series with skill-block house metaphor; NOT photorealistic, NOT shiny 3D, NOT corporate vector clip art.
Composition: landscape 3:2, large uncluttered subject groups with generous margins; legible when reduced to a phone width. The board and phone remain visibly separate but connected.
Text: Only the short proper name "SkillPilot" neatly above the board; no other words, numerals, captions, brand logos or watermarks.
Constraints: no AI-provider logos or fake product screenshots; no locks, privacy certification seals, automatic graduation, automatic marking of all goals achieved, server storing chat bubbles, or claim of all learning running locally. No charts or paper shown upside down to the learner. No decorative arrow maze.

review.status: editorial AI-reviewed candidate; no human approval claimed
review.disclosurePlacement: Shared italic notice beside Version/Project in the Whitepaper header

checks: Friendly abstract comic with recurring teal/blue skill blocks and a single orange active goal.
Large separate phone coach and stable learning board; structured tokens are not a chat-transcript storage claim.
Completed foundation blocks are checked; current orange and future outline blocks are not.
Only SkillPilot name, no AI-provider logos, certification seals or fake current product UI.
Conceptual skill pictograms are not a claim of an exact curricular dependency graph.
Generated PNG retained byte-for-byte with generation metadata.
